mapper.sql: id, admin_id AS adminId, admin_name AS adminName, method, path, `query`, ip, status, cost_ms AS costMs, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_admin_log (id, admin_id, admin_name, method, path, `query`, ip, status, cost_ms, create_time) values (#{id}, #{adminId}, #{adminName}, #{method}, #{path}, #{query}, #{ip}, #{status}, #{costMs}, now())
mapper.select:
select count(*) from fly_admin_log
and admin_name like concat('%', #{adminName}, '%') and path like concat('%', #{path}, '%') and create_time >= #{startTime} and create_time <= concat(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
